items.label: 3-Color Temperature Adjustable Floor Lamp
items.value: The SUNMORY shelf lamp is equipped with a 9W 800-lumen LED bulb and offers 3 color temperatures: 3000K / 5000K / 4000K; color temperature of the LED lamp can be switched according to different scenarios; making it suitable for various home decor styles; the floor lamp for living room, when paired with a smart plug, is compatible with Alexa, Google Home Assistant, and Apple HomeKit.

items.label: Non-glaring Cloth Lampshade
items.value: This shelf floor lamp is equipped with a high-quality off-white cloth lampshade and opens upwards; With the built-in three-color temperature bulb, it can be used for both functional lighting and ambient lighting, It is a piece of furniture that can decorate any style of room.

items.label: Storage and Display
items.value: Crafted from high-density fiberboard, this tall lamp features shelves each supporting over 50 pounds, delivering ample storage space and enhanced stability. It stores books, photo frames, decorative items, plants, and phones. Doubles as a corner lamp or nightstand with lamp.

items.label: Minimalist Design & Versatile Style
items.value: The contemporary stand up lamp matches asian, mid century modern, rustic, country and farmhouse decor thanks to its diverse lighting effects and simple lines. This shelf lamp is the home decoration and an ideal gift for the holidays.

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: SUNMORY shelf floor lamp has been improved in craftsmanship and simplified the installation steps; The package contains the tools required for assembly and an instruction manual with text and video installation steps to help you quickly install the shelf lamp.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Adjustable Color Temperature, Dimmable, Energy Efficient, Memory Function, Shelves
